cd main

stderr 'example\.com/capblame/z/importer: ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]'

! stderr 'Import chain \(cmd/go capabilities audit\)'

-- extunsafe/go.mod --
module example.com/extunsafe

go 1.27
-- extunsafe/u.go --
package extunsafe

import "unsafe"

func Size() uintptr { return unsafe.Sizeof(uintptr(0)) }
-- main/go.mod --
module example.com/capblame

go 1.27

require example.com/extunsafe v0.0.0

replace example.com/extunsafe => ../extunsafe
-- main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"
-- main/a/leaf/leaf.go --
package leaf

func Value() int { return 1 }
-- main/z/importer/importer.go --
package importer

import (
	"example.com/capblame/a/leaf"
	"example.com/extunsafe"
)

func Total() int { return leaf.Value() + int(extunsafe.Size()) }
